nodes.label: Recursion as an Inductive Proof
nodes.rationale: Two obligations and nothing else: base case correct, and inductive step correct ASSUMING smaller inputs work — plus progress under a well-founded measure. The practical skill is to stop tracing the call stack and check the obligations.

nodes.label: Pruning Is the Entire Algorithm
nodes.rationale: A rejection at depth d removes n^(n-d) leaves at once, so pruning changes the BASE of the exponent rather than shaving a constant. Measured N-queens: 50.38 us vs 2.20 s at n=9 (43,580x), growing from 305x at n=6 — so for backtracking, measure; don't estimate from the bound.

nodes.label: Make/Unmake State Restoration
nodes.rationale: At every search node the partial assignment is consistent and mutable state is exactly restored on the way back up. The make/unmake pair is separated by the recursive call, so any continue, early return, or ? skips the undo — the same shape as a missing free, and the compiler cannot help. Make it structurally unskippable with adjacency or a Drop guard.

nodes.label: Bitmask Search State
nodes.rationale: N-queens tracks columns and both diagonals as u32 masks; diagonals shift by one per row so d1<<1 and d2>>1 propagate attacks automatically. Feasibility for a whole row is one AND, and candidates are iterated with the x & -x lowest-set-bit trick — why 9-queens ran in 50 us.

nodes.label: Memoization Converts Backtracking into DP
nodes.rationale: The recursion tree has Theta(2^n) nodes but only Theta(n) distinct states; a two-line memo converts exponential to polynomial. Measured naive Fibonacci at n=40: 312.84 ms vs 333 ns with an array memo (~939,000x), and an array memo beat a HashMap memo by 13.4x because integer-indexed states need no hashing.

nodes.label: Recursion Depth Guard / Explicit Stack
nodes.rationale: The call stack is a fixed-size resource guarded by an unmapped page; overflow ABORTS and cannot be caught. Measured ~100k frames survive and 200k aborts on the 8 MB main thread, ~4x sooner on a 2 MB spawned thread, while an explicit stack handled 5,000,000. The trigger is input-controlled depth, not recursion itself.

nodes.label: Rust Does Not Guarantee Tail-Call Optimization
nodes.rationale: LLVM often does it in release when no destructors must run at the call site, but Drop semantics frequently prevent exactly that — and it is absent in debug builds where you would first hit the overflow. Write the loop.

edges.source_location: Both are the same fixed-size-stack abort measured on the 8 MB main thread vs 2 MB spawned thread, one at call time and one at drop time
Both are built on the x & -x lowest-set-bit trick as their core primitive
The 13.4x array-memo-over-HashMap-memo gap is the same integer-key hashing cost the hasher-provenance rule addresses
